mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and corporate earnings uncertainty, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal broad-based economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regime, industrial production above 105.0 index points indicates accelerating manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 in post-pandemic recovery, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales level above 400,000 million dollars (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 400000, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a monthly payroll increase above 100,000 jobs signals labor market improvement that reduces recession risk, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 100000 and UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and unemployment rate increase indicate monetary policy response to labor market weakness, signaling economic deterioration that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.05.
